methods 必须为技术 ID 字符串数组: methods must be an array of technology ID strings
背景段落必须包含文本标题和 HTML 或正文: Background sections must have string titles and HTML or body text
背景简介必须为文本: The background introduction must be a string
背景判断项必须为对象数组: Background judgements must be an array of objects
部分本地案例格式无效，已跳过加载，请检查原文件或备份。: Some local cases have invalid formats and were skipped. Check their original files or backups.
栅格显示去噪值或绝对误差；评估真值在样本读数中显示。: The raster shows denoised values or absolute errors. Evaluation targets appear in the sample readout.
仅显示遮挡区的预测减观测，保留原始深度位置；虚线为零误差。: Only masked intervals show predicted minus observed values at their original depth indices. The dashed line indicates zero error.
重建曲线只替换遮挡区；可见观测保持不变。: The reconstruction replaces only masked intervals and preserves visible observations.
类别条带显示当前方法、另一方法与评估标签；误差视图首条标记错分。: The strips show the selected method, the other method, and evaluation labels. The first error strip marks misclassifications.
显示完整观测曲线；界面候选由局部窗口特征计算。: The complete observed log is shown; boundary candidates are computed from local-window features.
分数与判定阈值定位候选，误差视图显示判定错误；评估标签只用于检验。: Scores and decision thresholds locate candidates. Error mode shows incorrect decisions; labels are used only for evaluation.
曲线显示预测减观测。: The curve shows predicted minus observed values.
当前方法的输出按测试样本排列；评估真值已隐藏。: Outputs from the selected method are arranged by test sample. Evaluation targets are hidden.
